justification: New /prospector UI page (5 components + filter-params lib + 2 test files) over the existing rate-limited lot-search API, plus two build fixes: usePathname null guard and pre-existing flood-truth-report footer prop mismatch. No DB writes, no existing data modified, read-only POST to existing endpoint.

pre_impl.existing_data: UI reads lot_search_index exclusively through the existing /api/lot-search Next.js route (Zod-validated, rate limited 20 per 60s, 10s statement timeout). No new queries, no schema changes, no writes anywhere in this PR.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Request bodies were verified field-by-field against the route's Zod schema on main: limit 50 within 1-500 cap, min_dwellings integer >=1, order_by restricted to the whitelisted column set, tri-state booleans omitted when indeterminate.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: All five components and the filter-params lib are new files under prospector/ namespaces; the only existing files touched are flood-truth-report.tsx (one footer prop shape fix to unblock the main build) and the shared test setup, so regression surface is the PDF footer render only.

functions.name: parseFilters
functions.purpose: Parses URL search params into typed ProspectorFilters with positive-number and tri-state guards so shared URLs cannot inject invalid API values
functions.input: URLSearchParams from the shared or refreshed page URL
functions.output: Typed ProspectorFilters object with nulls for absent or invalid params
functions.if_none: Empty params object yields DEFAULT_FILTERS so the page renders the unfiltered Inner West result set

functions.name: serializeFilters
functions.purpose: Inverse of parseFilters; round-trip tested so browser back/forward and shared links reproduce identical search state
functions.input: ProspectorFilters state object after a user filter interaction
functions.output: URLSearchParams containing only non-default fields for a clean shareable URL
functions.if_none: Default filters serialize to an empty query string and router.push uses bare pathname

functions.name: buildSearchBody
functions.purpose: Maps UI filter state to the exact Zod request shape including page-to-offset conversion and omission of empty fields
functions.input: ProspectorFilters plus page number for offset pagination
functions.output: JSON body matching the route Zod schema with limit 50 and computed offset
functions.if_none: Missing optional fields are omitted entirely rather than sent as null, which Zod would reject

functions.name: applyFilters
functions.purpose: Pushes filter state into the URL via router.push with null-guarded pathname (build fix) so state survives refresh and sharing
functions.input: Next ProspectorFilters object from updateFilters merge
functions.output: router.push call updating the URL without scroll reset
functions.if_none: Null pathname (pre-fix crash) now falls back to /prospector so navigation never receives null

functions.name: postFetcher
functions.purpose: SWR fetcher for POST bodies; paired with shouldRetryOnError false on all three hooks so a 429 from the rate limiter is not amplified by retries
functions.input: Tuple of url and JSON body string used as the SWR cache key
functions.output: Parsed JSON response typed as SearchResponse or SummaryResponse
functions.if_none: Non-OK response throws with the API error message which SWR exposes as hook error for the banner

values.name: shouldRetryOnError=false
values.why: SWR default exponential backoff would re-POST after a 429 and keep the user rate-limited; surfaced error banner instead
values.value: false on search, summary and options hooks
values.if_missing: Default SWR retry re-POSTs after 429 responses and keeps the user inside the rate limit window indefinitely

values.name: pathname ?? '/prospector'
values.why: usePathname types as string|null under this Next version; null fallback fixes the Vercel compile failure on line 68
values.if_missing: tsc fails with TS2322 string|null not assignable, which is the exact Vercel build failure this PR fixes

values.name: Indicative GFA labels
values.why: Renamed from Realistic GFA before public launch — realistic implies an achievability claim the liability framework prohibits
values.if_missing: Realistic GFA implies an achievability claim that conflicts with the liability language framework before public launch

queries.purpose: Search POST to /api/lot-search with filters, pagination offset and whitelisted order_by
queries.guards: Zod schema on route plus client-side positive-number parsing; limit capped at 500 server-side
queries.where_clause: Server-side Zod validation plus lga_name filter; client never constructs SQL

queries.purpose: Summary POST with summary=true returning aggregate stats for the dashboard cards
queries.guards: Same rate limiter bucket; keepPreviousData avoids blank flicker between filter changes
queries.where_clause: Same validated filter body with summary=true; aggregates computed server-side only

queries.purpose: Options POST with default filters per LGA so zone and binding constraint lists do not shrink as filters apply
queries.guards: revalidateIfStale false caches the option lists for the session
queries.where_clause: DEFAULT_FILTERS scoped to lga_name only so option lists cover the whole LGA

break_it.scenario: User changes filters rapidly: each change fires search plus summary POSTs, ~10 interactions exhaust the 20 per 60s rate limiter and every request returns 429
break_it.what_happens: Error banner renders from search.error or summary.error; with shouldRetryOnError false SWR does not re-POST, so the budget recovers after the window instead of being consumed by retries
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated in this PR via SWR config
break_it.how: shouldRetryOnError false on all three SWR hooks; error banner shows the API message instead of retry storms
break_it.repro: UI action: toggle heritage tri-state and zone checkboxes 12 times within 60 seconds on the preview deploy, watch network tab fill with 429s

break_it.scenario: Shared URL contains page=99999 or a negative area bound crafted by hand
break_it.what_happens: parsePositiveNumber and parsePositiveInt drop invalid values to null; huge page yields an offset query the 10s statement timeout backstops and the table shows the empty state
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated by client-side parse guards and server caps
break_it.how: parsePositiveNumber/parsePositiveInt null invalid input; server caps limit at 500 and statement timeout backstops large offsets
break_it.repro: UI action: open /prospector?page=99999&min_area=-5 in the browser and observe empty-state table without console errors

break_it.scenario: Summary endpoint returns zone_distribution rows with null zone_code for lots missing zoning data
break_it.what_happens: zoneOptions filter predicate (z is string, ProspectorClient.tsx:131) removes nulls before sort, so the filter dropdown never renders a blank option that would serialize as an empty zone_codes entry
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated by the type-guard filter predicate
break_it.how: type-guard filter predicate strips null zone codes before sorting the dropdown options
break_it.repro: curl -s -X POST /api/lot-search -d '{"lga_name":"INNER WEST","limit":1}' with summary=true and inspect zone_distribution for null zone_code rows

break_it.scenario: Flood Truth refused-report page renders the footer with the old page/total prop names after the PDF component API changed
break_it.what_happens: Previously a silent TS2322 build failure on main blocking every Vercel deploy; now passes reportName plus pageNum matching PlotDetectFooter's signature, verified by tsc zero errors
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated by the footer prop fix in this PR
break_it.how: footer call updated to reportName/pageNum prop names; tsc --noEmit now reports zero errors
break_it.repro: npx tsc --noEmit in frontend-nextjs before the fix reproduces TS2322 at lib/pdf/flood-truth-report.tsx:471

break_it.scenario: Statewide build lands and an LGA has more than 20 distinct zone codes while the options call still serves the LIMIT 20 zone_distribution
break_it.what_happens: Zone filter silently omits less common zones — documented as a known follow-up in the launch plan; not fixed here because route.ts aggregation belongs to a separate API change
break_it.mitigated: Not mitigated here — tracked as post-merge follow-up
break_it.repro: After statewide build: POST summary=true for lga_name BLACKTOWN and count zone_distribution rows against SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT zone_code) for that LGA
break_it.how: Deliberately deferred: requires route.ts aggregation change; recorded in post_merge and the launch plan fix list

post_merge.db_reset: No database changes in this PR; statement_timeout reset and compute downgrade are tracked separately in the statewide build runbook
post_merge.secrets: No new env vars, keys, or secrets introduced; UI calls the same-origin API route only
post_merge.other_repo: No other repository affected; EnvelopeView and monitor repos untouched by this change
post_merge.manual_verify: Open Vercel preview /prospector, run three searches per launch gate G1, confirm 429 shows banner without retry storm, and check the flood truth refused-report PDF footer renders
